description: Edit an existing image asset with an instruction (change colours, add a hat, fix a detail…). The edit is added as a new frame; the original stays. 5 credits.

frameId.description: Optional: the frame the new frames hang under in the editor (usually the frame referenceFile came from).

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

images.description: Optional extra reference images: image keys from get_asset or https URLs

referenceFile.description: Work from one image of an existing frame instead of the asset's base: pass an image key exactly as get_asset lists it. Empty = the asset's current base image.

remove_bg.description: Remove the background from the result, as the app's editor does. Set false for artwork or a scene that should keep its background

name: edit_image
